title: tabernaemontana glandulosa
intro: Tabernaemontana glandulosa, commonly known as the Yellow Chalice Vine or Yellow Mandevilla, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana glandulosa include pain relief, fever reduction, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, particularly voacangine and voacristine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
